fields.description: Issue includes political commentary on the Miami Beach election and the swearing-in of Mayor Turk and councilmen Burnett Roth and Melvin Richard; an editorial campaign arguing racetracks and pari-mutuel betting foster crime and juvenile delinquency; reporting on an alleged Dade County delinquent tax-certificate sale “combine” that keeps interest rates high; coverage of an anti–H. Leslie Quigg press offensive in advance of Miami city elections; a note on Florida Power & Light financing and municipal ownership debates; local civic/government features (municipal services tour), a Tropicana Bar nuisance trial ending in a split jury, and other local columns and briefs.
